public_rationale: No decisive event meeting the resolution rule was established. Microsoft's announced Abilene campus shows demand from another large buyer, but concerns an adjacent development announced before the forecast. The reviewed record does not establish that it replaces the commitments discussed in the post. With no deadline, the absence of a qualifying replacement purchase by October 28 cannot support the forecast.
limitations: The capacity portfolio and comparison scale are incompletely specified.
An abandoned expansion negotiation is not necessarily a default on committed compute.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: No one else will buy the compute committed to by OpenAI and Anthropic, because the companies meant to buy it can't afford it and nobody else is buying compute at even close to that scale.

statement.excerpt: No they won’t. As I’ll get into, the companies that are meant to buy the compute can’t afford it, and nobody else is buying compute at even close to that scale.

from_speaker: someone else will buy the compute
the companies that are meant to buy the compute can’t afford it
nobody else is buying compute at even close to that scale
our_interpretation: The forecast concerns replacement demand for the large compute commitments discussed in the post, rather than whether any other company buys any compute.
The plain reading is that other buyers will not absorb that capacity at a scale comparable to the labs' commitments.
The affordability and current-demand statements are reasons offered for the forecast; they do not themselves establish its outcome.
No express conditional antecedent or deadline is stated. A release of capacity is a necessary opportunity to test replacement demand, not an event assumed to have occurred.
Comparable scale requires evidence tied to the identified capacity and its economic value, rather than a small unrelated contract.
criteria.support_condition: The identified commitments reach a final disposition after the labs relinquish the capacity, and the relevant capacity is permanently retired or otherwise becomes unavailable for replacement purchase without other buyers absorbing it at comparable scale.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated, binding replacement purchases show other customers absorbing a substantial, comparable-scale portion of the identified committed capacity relinquished by the labs.
